limits: Semantic caching is described as precomputing query embeddings; real semantic caches key stored responses on embedding similarity.
'Feature injection' is not a standard LLM term and is not defined precisely.
AI agents are defined as single LLM instances doing one task, narrower than current usage.
No numbers on latency or cost.

figures.caption: A gen AI's encoder and decoder work together to produce accurate outputs.
